title: Root selection by step-size continuation for discrete-gradient integrators of nonconvex gradient flows: programs of the numerical experiments
description:
Python programs that generate every number, table and figure of the numerical experiments of the article Root selection by step-size continuation for discrete-gradient integrators of nonconvex gradient flows by Francisco R. Villatoro. They include the continuation algorithm for discrete-gradient steps, energy certificates for computed chords and paths, a verification of chord classifications in exact rational arithmetic with outward bounds at 48 decimal digits, an interval verification at 70 decimal digits for a coordinate sweep, and experiments with scalar and planar potential wells, log-sum-exp energies in dimensions 16 and 32, a discretized Allen-Cahn equation and time-refinement studies.

This work was supported by the Universidad de Málaga, Spain, through project PRO-B4-2026-011 of its Plan Propio de Investigación, Transferencia y Divulgación Científica.
